hyperparameters.method: Ridge off/def ratings for pace and points per 100 (refit weekly on earlier blocks, prior-season decay 0.35, 120-day half-life); D adds rest/back-to-back terms fitted on development.

hypothesis: Opponent defence and pace explain team points beyond the team's own average.
limitations: Opponent strength and pace matter for team totals far more than for individual props.

point.result: Validation MAE/CRPS: A 9.67/6.844; B 9.59/6.790; C 9.44/6.664; D 9.41/6.641. Holdout best D_ratings_plus_rest: MAE 9.46, CRPS 6.698, vs A -0.339 (95% CI -0.420 to -0.251).

question: Does a pace x efficiency model with schedule-adjusted ratings beat team scoring averages?
